events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Jones (PHX) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Although Jones reaches in and makes contact with the ball, Harden (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Phoenix is awarded possession when play resumes.

Harden (LAC) is positioned inside of the restricted area at the time of the contact with Durant (PHX) during his shooting motion. Since Harden is a secondary defender attempting to draw an offensive foul, the contact is considered illegal.
Booker (PHX) briefly engages with Zubac (LAC) in the post but the contact is marginal and does not impact Zubac's ability to establish post position or receive the pass.
O'Neale (PHX) briefly engages with Zubac (LAC) during the rebound and Zubac does not lose his balance as a result of any illegal contact.
Harden (LAC) is in a legal guarding position and there is no contact between the two players when Durant (PHX) loses his footing on the perimeter.

Durant (PHX) initially gets his hand on the ball, but Harden (LAC) maintains possession and continues to the basket. Durant then initiates illegal contact to Harden's arm that affects his driving shot attempt.

Harden (LAC) avoids making illegal contact with Durant (PHX) during his shooting motion. Following the release of the jump shot attempt, Harden appears to graze Durant's head but it does not affect his ability to follow through. There is incidental contact between the two players as they return to the floor and Durant's momentum carries him backwards, but Harden allows Durant to land.
Jones (PHX) reaches for the ball across Harden's (LAC) back but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Beal (PHX) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Harden's (LAC) driving shot attempt.

Jones Jr. (LAC) retracts his arms as he establishes himself in a screening position in Durant's (PHX) path. Jones Jr. is moved backwards as a result of the contact with Durant and he does not illegally re-position himself in Durant's path.
O'Neale (PHX) attempts to jump vertically, but turns in mid-air and delivers body contact to Jones Jr. (LAC) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Durant (PHX) jumps towards the basket and after the release of Jones Jr.'s (LAC) driving shot attempt, there is incidental contact as a result of his momentum carrying him forwards into Durant.
Coffey (LAC) steps into Beal's (PHX) path and initiates illegal contact that causes him to trip.
Powell (LAC) bring his hand underneath the ball to gather just as he plants his right foot and then takes two legal steps to the basket before coming to a stop.
Harden (LAC) steps into Beal's (PHX) path and causes him to lose his balance and control of the ball.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Beal's (PHX) pass goes out of bounds,.
Beal (PHX) legally contests Powell's (LAC) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Coffey (LAC) legally contests Durant's (PHX) jump shot attempt and allows him to land.
Allen (PHX) is not in a legal guarding position when he moves laterally into Harden (LAC), initiating illegal contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Jones Jr. (LAC) grabs and pulls Nurkic's (PHX) arm, causing him to lose his balance after he secures the rebound.
